evidence_notes: Main contribution audits learned metanetwork readers of neural fields; the LLM-reader experiment (GPT-6 family reading six-digit weights of width-32 ReLU shape fields, 60 origins) is a side study (PAGE 5, PAGE 8, App. H PAGE 20-21), so peripheral; read-only, no weights written. Only the prospective Astra/Sol collection fixed prompts, inclusion rule and Holm family before collection (PAGE 5, PAGE 21), with no registry or timestamp, hence partial. Redacted-weight and explicit-cue controls act as null controls; small next-token models (Qwen2.5-0.5B same letter on all inputs, Qwen3.5-27B 7/60) fail where Astra/Sol reach ~87% (PAGE 8, 21). LLM usage statement: OpenAI Codex assisted design, implementation, execution, analysis and manuscript (PAGE 9). Target size not stated (width-32 one-hidden-layer 2-D ReLU field, ~129 params by architecture); artifact referenced but no link.
